text:
I'm looking to rent the 1954 Wexcombe Regent for a period drama shoot, which I think will be a lot of fun - I've always been fascinated by the old cars from that era. I'm planning to get it from your garage on 29th June 2027, and we'd like to use it from 10 am until 19:30. I've attached my driving licence for your records. I've actually had a bit of a nostalgic streak lately, and working on this shoot has really got me excited about the project. Anyway, I'm really looking forward to hearing back from you.

Una Dunsmere
